brand.notes: Every visible wordmark uses the \ac macro: running header, date line, abstract, body and the Consent paragraph show the period in AC pink at full-page resolution. Bibliography howpublished fields carry a plain period (a .bib field cannot colour it), the same convention as Edit the Harness.

diagrams.notes: Revised after a first render where the goal node collided with the route label. Now a full-width pink banner with five straight dashed drops (contract, checks, route, extension, board), each labelled to its right with clear air; the main row reads left to right; the three teal routes fan and rejoin symmetrically; the pink repair loop runs below in its own channel; the post label sits with space between file and board. Sans labels legible at print size; nothing crosses.

figures.notes: Full poster, uncropped, 1200x1800 raster of the run SVG. The giant 14, amber planet and orbit and the grid rules read at page size; the 11px info rows are small by the model own design, and the caption does not lean on them.
The full input image (720 px square) with the haiku typeset beneath, both inside the figure; the heart on the canvas the haiku names is visible. Caption identifies input and output.

Full-width piano roll from score.json; pitch labels, bar numbers, legend and the noise lane all read at page size after the type was enlarged; nothing clipped. Caption says what it is drawn from and what it shows.
